name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 76 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 29% fewer than the week before, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 76 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 29 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: Gunfire struck tents at the Rafah displacement site in Gaza as aid teams prepared for winter storms, while Israeli fire in the Gaza Strip killed seven people, including a 13-year-old boy. Israeli forces beat a Palestinian university president during an IDF raid in the West Bank and shot dead a 14-year-old boy there, and movement restrictions continue to hamper health actors such as MSF. The Israeli prime minister's office allowed winter supplies to enter Gaza but said Hamas must disarm before reconstruction can proceed. Formula 1 champion Lewis Hamilton visited Gaza aid facilities on the Egyptian side of the Rafah crossing. The United Nations reported 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Skudd traff telt på Rafah-flyktningleiren i Gaza mens hjelpearbeidere forberedte seg på vinterstormer, mens israelsk ild i Gazastripen drepte syv personer, inkludert en 13‑årig gutt. Israelske styrker slo en palestinsk universitetspresident under et IDF-angrep på Vestbredden og skjøt en 14‑årig gutt der til døde, og bevegelsesrestriksjoner fortsetter å hindre helseaktører som MSF. Israels statsministerkontor tillot vinterforsyninger å komme inn i Gaza, men sa at Hamas må avvæpnes før gjenoppbygging kan fortsette. Formel‑1‑mesteren Lewis Hamilton besøkte hjelpesentre i Gaza på den egyptiske siden av Rafah-overgangen. FN rapporterte 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters have denied that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
